description: This file is a shell script testing various 'git branch' command options such as --contains, --no-contains, --merged, and --no-merged. It sets up git repository states and verifies branch listing behaviors in different scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the provided command fails.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the provided input is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the actual and expected output.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or state.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified changes.
